title: Bicycle cargo repair and evacuation check
summary: Checks a bicycle before moving water, food, medicines, or evacuation bags.
content: Bicycle cargo repair and evacuation check is a practical offline routine for transport repair. Check brakes, tires, chain, steering, lights/reflectors, rack, and loose bolts before loading. Balance loads low and centered; keep bags away from wheels and brakes. Test ride empty and then with partial load before carrying critical supplies. Separate clean water/food from fuel, chemicals, trash, and dirty tools. Stop using the bicycle if braking, wobble, tire damage, or rider fatigue becomes unsafe.
